description: This Java source file defines the 'QueryThingsPerRequestActor' class, an Akka actor responsible for handling search queries (QueryThings), retrieving matching 'Thing' entities from a backend, and responding with combined results. It manages the actor lifecycle, message processing, and inter-actor communication within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within the gateway proxy service.

classes.name: QueryThingsPerRequestActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that handles 'QueryThings' requests in the gateway, manages retrieval of 'Thing' entities, and responds with combined search results, including handling of out-of-sync notifications.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates an Akka Props configuration object for instantiating QueryThingsPerRequestActor instances with the given parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior of the actor, including timeout, response processing, and message forwarding.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldsWithThingId
methods.description: Extracts and adjusts field selection to include the Thing ID for search results.

methods.name: getEntitiesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Maps retrieved entities to include only the fields specified in the original QueryThings request.

methods.name: notifyOutOfSyncThings
methods.description: Detects 'Thing' IDs that are out of sync and publishes a 'ThingsOutOfSync' event via pub-sub.
